name: What is included in a professional garage trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a professional garage trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage trim installation involves measuring, cutting, and securing molding around garage door openings, interior entry doors, windows, and along the baseboards. The process starts by removing any damaged, rotted, or cracked boards and inspecting the underlying framing. Crews then measure the openings, cut durable trim materials such as cellular PVC or treated exterior wood, and secure them with corrosion-resistant fasteners. Joints are tightly caulked with high-grade exterior sealant to block moisture and drafts, followed by paint or finish to match your home exterior. Professional finish carpenters ensure clean miter cuts and flush seams that keep weather elements out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage trim installation includes removing old molding, inspecting underlying framing, cutting and securing durable trim around doors or windows, and sealing joints against moisture.
